heading: Facilities
learningSub: Every programme includes hands-on practical training in fully equipped labs — not just classroom theory.
facility1Body: Fully equipped simulation labs for hands-on practice in OT techniques, patient care, and lab procedures — supervised by experienced faculty.
facility2Body: Real diagnostic equipment used for practical training in medical laboratory technique programmes, mirroring hospital-grade instruments.
facility3Body: Projector-enabled classrooms for theory sessions, case discussions, and multimedia learning modules.
facility4Body: A dedicated reading room with textbooks, journals, and reference material aligned to NSQF course curricula.
